description:
Upload an image, video (mp4/webm), audio (mp3/wav/m4a/aac), .srt subtitles (<= 2 MiB UTF-8), 3D mesh (glb, gltf, fbx, obj, stl), or a document for Gemini chat, presentations, or document jobs, up to 10 MiB, as base64.

Returns key and url; either can be used as a media, subtitle, or 3D mesh reference (for example Higgsfield
image_urls/video_urls/audio_urls, heygen-translate srt_url, Gemini chat video_url/input_audio/image_url, or 3D
model_url in estimate_3d_process / create_3d_process). The file type is checked by content, not by the header.

Subtitles (.srt): videos:write, chat:write, or uploads:write accepts UTF-8 .srt up to 2 MiB ('-->' timecodes, BOM
stripped) for heygen-translate srt_url (paired with srt_role="input"|"output") and Gemini chat. Documents:
chat:write or uploads:write accepts PDF, DOCX, DOC, DOTX, ODT, PPTX, PPT, ODP, XLSX, XLS, ODS, TXT, MD, and CSV
for Gemini chat_completion file_url parts (up to 10 MiB in MCP, 50 MiB via HTTP multipart); presentations:write /
documents:write accepts PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, MD, CSV for file_urls of create_presentation,
revise_presentation, create_document and revise_document; filename is ASCII-normalized.
name: upload_media
